up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL376359 (ALOGLIPTIN) and all its salts. Include the parent compound and all related salts using the molecule_hierarchy parent mapping (finding all children of CHEMBL376359). For these compounds, return all rows where the standard_type is 'IC50' and standard_units is 'nM' against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Join the tables using the FAQ salts pattern: filter the compound set by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, join compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and join docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not use activities.molregno as the activity join key. Return exactly compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH compound_set AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT child.molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
    JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cs_filter
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cs_filter.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';

up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL376359 (ALOGLIPTIN) and all its salts which have an IC50 bioactivity value in nM against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). First, find the parent molecule by checking if CHEMBL376359 has a parent_molregno in molecule_hierarchy; if it does, use that parent, otherwise use CHEMBL376359 as the parent. Then get all related salts (children) via molecule_hierarchy parent_molregno. For this compound set (parent + salts), join using the FAQ salts pattern: filter by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, join compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and join docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not use activities.molregno. Filter for standard_type='IC50' and standard_units='nM' and target CHEMBL284. Return exactly compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Return all rows.
sql:
WITH parent_info AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN mh.parent_molregno IS NOT NULL THEN mh.parent_molregno
            ELSE md.molregno 
        END AS parent_molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary md
    LEFT JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.molregno = md.molregno
    WHERE md.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'
),
compound_set AS (
    SELECT parent_molregno AS molregno FROM parent_info
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mh.molregno
    FROM parent_info pi
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = pi.parent_molregno
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM compound_set cs_filter
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cs_filter.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN activities a ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
